L0H0_ATTN.hypothesis: Attends to positions sharing the same token value as the query, copying their content (content-matched routing); in r2 baseline, max attention per query is 0.37-0.64 concentrated on 1-2 same-valued positions; zeroing it in r4 leaves predictions intact, consistent with routing rather than aggregating.

L0_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses two distinct upstream signals—the token+position embedding and the L0H0_ATTN write—into a non-binary output; r4 shows its write changes by mean 0.29 when L0H0_ATTN is ablated, confirming two distinct sources.

L1_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses three distinct upstream signals—token embedding, L0H0_ATTN, and L0_MLP writes; r4 shows change 0.54 when L0H0_ATTN ablated, r6 shows change 1.49 when L0_MLP ablated.

L2_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses four distinct upstream signals—token embedding, L0H0_ATTN, L0_MLP, and L1_MLP writes; ablating it in r11 badly disrupts predictions (e.g. [3,6,6,6,12,6,8,6,3,3] vs correct [9,4,8,4,12,8,8,6,1,3]).
